Michi sits comfortably near a large open journal at the trail's end in the bottom half, gently touching a pencil, looking upward with a happy calm expression. Fine sunny apricot circular backdrop, a small plant and crisp tiny pixel accents. The note trail is a visual metaphor for keeping an everyday record; do not depict earning coins, leveling up from spending, a staircase, rewards or automatic scanning. Tall sophisticated composition with headline in upper quarter and ample margins.
Palette: pale mint, ivory, apricot, sage, teal, dark navy. Overall polished cozy pixel-art advertising illustration with crisp intentional pixel edges and rich readable objects. Keep the original mascot lovable and consistent; do not turn it into a different cat, generic anime, vector art, photo or plastic 3D toy.
Text, verbatim, in natural correct Mexican Spanish:
Brand: "Sobrita"
Main headline: "Pequeños gastos.\nUn gran hábito."
Secondary line: "Registra tu día con Sobrita."
Small bottom footer: "Control de gastos · Android"
Typesetting: clean heavy rounded sans-serif headline, smaller highly legible secondary line, medium-sized Sobrita wordmark with its exact spelling. Preserve all accents, inverted question marks and punctuation. Use the supplied line breaks. The whole image must contain only these four text elements. Generous whitespace, no text over detailed art. Keep every word and important character safely away from the outer edges with at least 6 percent margin. Aim for art to occupy about 65 percent of the design and concise text about 25 percent. Footer small but readable. The navy identity color should anchor each light composition; on dark composition use cream/lavender text.
Constraints: a genuinely NEW concept to add to an existing 10-image ad set, not a translated or lightly rearranged old image. Only ONE cat, no humans or other pets. Do not add fake app screenshots, transaction balances, unverified features, download buttons, prices, ratings, Google Play badges, bank logos, financial savings guarantees or watermarks. Background must be fully opaque. Deliver one production-ready image in the required aspect ratio.
